title: Talking to a companion: the same loop with an addressee
description: A companion joins the party; the player then talks to her directly (a companion-mode turn: same DM, same tools, game time passes, she remembers the talk in her Character Model). On dm-loop-v1 only.

steps.say: I ask Tamsin, a young drover heading the same way, to travel with me. She agrees.
Tamsin, what do you make of the work organiser?

expect.label: the companion turn used the loop's tools
game time passed during the talk

recruit.note: A companion is a character with party membership; her model starts in the same turn.

rounds.text: Tamsin shrugs the switch onto her other shoulder and grins. "Same road, better company. Why not."

arguments.name: Tamsin
arguments.description: A young drover heading the same way.

current.goal: get her herd money to the coast

talk.note: The companion answers in her own voice; the DM records what she now thinks.

rounds.text: Tamsin glances back at the square. "Him? Keeps good books and bad hours. A man who counts carts that carefully is counting something else too."

arguments.reason: a quiet talk on the road

beliefs.text: The organiser hides something about the mill.

episodes.meaning: The hero asked her honest opinion and listened.

rounds.text: "But I'd still take his coin," she adds.
